the interdisciplinary approach to the field of transnationalism and immigration has been a success.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, in spite of the differences in disciplinary agendas and research methods, the study of immigrant transnationalism has become a field of study in its own right, one that has been enriched by the contributions of scholars in various disciplines.

the interdisciplinary approach to the field of immigration and transmigration has been very productive, but that there is still a long way to go to achieve the kind of mutual education and integration among disciplines that would make the study of immigration a truly interdisciplinary field.
we have been able to demonstrate that the transnationalism literature is an interdisciplinary field of inquiry that has been able to generate new knowledge and new ways of looking at the world.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the study of immigration, transnationalism, and diasporic communities is a highly interdisciplinary endeavor, one that requires a high degree of mutual understanding and respect among scholars working in different fields of study.

the study of immigrant transnationalism is an excellent case for interdisciplinary research, and that the study of transnationalism is a promising field of study for advancing interdisciplinary scholarship in the social sciences.

there is no single, universal, or best way to study the phenomenon of transnationalism, and that the best way to study it is to combine different disciplinary approaches and methods.
